newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - May 7.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - May 7.

text.p: * Cisco Systems Inc was trading at 56 during the after-hours session against a close of 57-3/4 on Nasdaq following the release of its quarterly earnings, traders said Tuesday.

* Fluor Corp was down $4 to $52 in London after the engineering, construction and diversified services company said late Tuesday it expected to report a loss for the second quarter of about $70 million, or $0.83 a share.
* Intel Corp was up 1/4 at $158-1/4 in London after dropping $4-1/2 in New York on Tuesday after the company warned that there was a possible flaw with the company's Pentium chips.

* Chrysler Corp was up 1/4 at $31-1/4 in London after New York Times reported the automaker reached an agreement with the United Auto Workers union which would end a nearly month-long strike that has shut down production of some high-profit vehicles.
